keyword: happy st patrick's day in irish
claims: The most common way to say "Happy St. Patrick's Day" in Irish is Lá Fhéile Pádraig sona duit.
Lá Fhéile Pádraig sona duit is pronounced Law fay-luh Paw-drig suna gwitch.
Lá Fhéile Pádraig sona duit means "Happy St. Patrick's Day to you".
Lá Fhéile Pádraig sona daoibh is pronounced Law leh Paw-drig suna yee-uv.
Lá Fhéile Pádraig sona daoibh! means "Happy St. Patrick’s Day to y'all".
Beannachtaí na Féile Pádraig ort! means "St. Patrick's Festival blessings upon you".
